title: Workspace activity at a glance
summary: The overview stacks a month of commits across every open repository, deleted stashes and remote branches get the slash animation, and a tab's menu copies the repository's path.

features.title: Combined activity in the overview
features.body: A month of commits across every open repository, one column per day stacking each repository in its own colour, with a legend and per-repository detail on hover.

features.title: Copy a repository's path
features.body: A tab's right-click menu copies the repository's path.

improvements.title: Slash animation for stashes and remote branches
improvements.body: Deleting a stash or a remote branch plays the same slash animation as a local branch.
